_about: Page-runs of the 1900 «Матеріалы»: spans of scans the edition serves as one document rather than one leaf at a time. The shape is The Chukchee's (its runs.json carries `_shape`; harness/apparatus.py reads both). This book prints one piece of apparatus, the Оглавленіе over four leaves; it has no List of Illustrations, no Authorities Quoted and no alphabet. Chapters are runs too, derived from edition/toc.json and the milestones in the text (harness/chapters.py) rather than declared here.
